mapper.select: select tsd.test_session_detail_id, tsd.sign_word_id, sw.sign_word_name, ts.test_session_type, tsd.is_correct, tsd.answer_date from test_session_detail tsd join test_session ts on tsd.test_session_id = ts.test_session_id join sign_word sw on tsd.sign_word_id = sw.sign_word_id where ts.member_id = #{memberId} and ts.test_session_type = 'WORD' order by tsd.answer_date desc limit #{start}, #{limit}
select count(*) from test_session_detail tsd join test_session ts on tsd.test_session_id = ts.test_session_id where ts.member_id = #{memberId} and ts.test_session_type = 'WORD'
